name: immich-public-proxy-upload
description: Lets visitors of an Immich Public Proxy share send photos and videos back to it.
author: Alan Grainger

scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "tsc -b -w --preserveWatchOutput ../shared" "tsx watch src/index.ts" "tsc -w -p tsconfig.client.json"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "tsx watch src/index.ts" "tsc -w -p tsconfig.client.json"
scripts.test:container: podman build --build-arg PACKAGE_VERSION=$(npm pkg get version | xargs) --format docker -f ../Dockerfile.upload -t immich-proxy-upload-test .. && podman run -it -p=3001:3000 --env-file .env -e IPP_PORT=3000 --restart=always immich-proxy-upload-test
